blockers.title: Real EXPO_PUBLIC_RN_API_KEY (HOLO_KEY_RN) not provisioned
blockers.detail: services/platform/config/secrets.yaml contains the placeholder 'replace-me-rn-key'. The fail-closed harness scripts/e2e/run-maestro-reference-flow.sh requires EXPO_PUBLIC_RN_API_KEY and the platform scoped-key middleware (services/platform/src/http/middleware/scoped-key.ts) validates against env.HOLO_KEY_RN. Without a real scoped key, the chat-runs POST is rejected 401.
blockers.unblock: Populate services/platform/config/secrets.yaml (operator-local, gitignored) with a real HOLO_KEY_RN value, OR inject EXPO_PUBLIC_RN_API_KEY via process env when launching the harness. Verify with `holo secrets doctor` (presence-only check) + a real POST /api/chat-runs.

blockers.title: Real ZERO_ADMIN_PASSWORD not provisioned
blockers.detail: The harness starts zero-cache with --admin-password="$ZERO_ADMIN_PASSWORD". No env var is set and no real password is in any visible config. Without it zero-cache cannot be started; without zero-cache the chat reply cannot sync back via Zero.
blockers.unblock: Generate a strong admin password; export ZERO_ADMIN_PASSWORD in the operator shell that runs the harness; ensure zero-cache is reachable on the configured port.

blockers.title: FLEET_URL pointing at a real inference endpoint not provisioned
blockers.detail: A process at /Users/inference1/Projects/rogueone/.tmp/local-loop-fleet-proxy.ts is running, but it belongs to the rogueone project and may not satisfy holocron's fleet contract. services/platform/config/secrets.yaml has FLEET_URL: http://127.0.0.1:4545/v1 but FLEET_KEY: sk-none (placeholder). The cold-boot chat round-trip needs a fleet that actually responds with a real LLM message that produces a Postgres write replicating through Zero.
blockers.unblock: Confirm local-loop-fleet-proxy.ts serves holocron's fleet contract (POST /v1/chat/completions or equivalent); OR point FLEET_URL at a real fleet (tailnet mini per Sprint 01); verify a real chat reply flows back through platform → Postgres → zero-cache → app.

blockers.title: zero-cache not currently running
blockers.detail: The harness starts zero-cache itself, but only when ZERO_ADMIN_PASSWORD is set. No long-running zero-cache process is currently up; the in-app ZeroProvider will fail to sync until one is.
blockers.unblock: Resolve B2 first, then the harness will start zero-cache during --run. For iterative dev, run zero-cache manually against holocron_nonprod.

blockers.title: S-COLDBOOT-01 dropped NotificationToastProvider from the cold-boot layout — reviewer must approve scope
blockers.detail: commit 97338b7 on task/S-COLDBOOT-01 removed <NotificationToastProvider/> from app/_layout.tsx because its module graph transitively imports convex/react (NotificationListSheet.tsx:1) and would crash at import when EXPO_PUBLIC_CONVEX_URL is unset. This is required by AC-2 (zero convex/react on boot) but is a behavioural regression for the reference build (notifications UI absent from cold-boot surface). Reintroducing it requires a non-Convex notification source, deferred to a later UC-SYNC task.
blockers.unblock: react-native-ui-reviewer to disposition: accept as in-scope (notification UI absent from reference build is acceptable for CAP-CUT-01 thin vertical) OR request a narrower edit (e.g. dynamic import gated on a flag) and re-verify AC-2/AC-3.

blockers.title: tests/integration/sprint20-maestro-harness.test.ts fails under bun test (stderr capture)
blockers.detail: The baseline 'fails closed when the named simulator contract is absent' test reports empty stderr under `bun test` while the same spawnSync call from a standalone script returns the expected 'maestro-reference-flow: MAESTRO_DEVICE must name an available iOS Simulator' message. Direct bash invocation of the harness produces correct exit 1 + stderr. This appears to be a bun-test spawnSync stderr isolation issue, not a harness defect.
blockers.unblock: Either fix the test to use combined stdout+stderr capture (`spawnSync(..., {stdio: ['ignore', 'pipe', 'pipe']})` + redirect `2>&1` inside the case), or move the test to vitest proper. Then merge task/D03-01 which extends these tests.
